key_insight: Wake-aware optimization favors high-power operation near λ = 10, with L/D = 0.20 delivering the highest system power coefficient and lowest peak thrust among high-power candidates.
engineering_relevance: The surrogate supports power–thrust trade-off analysis for tandem twin-rotor turbines sharing a support structure.
method: Simulate 160 configurations under turbulent inflow using a vortex method.
Predict 600 s power, thrust, and torque histories with per-time-node XGBoost models, then extend them with CNN-Attention-LSTM.
Use a genetic algorithm to balance system power and thrust coefficients.
evidence_signal: Ten-fold cross-validation on unseen configurations yielded median power-history R² values of 0.995 upstream and 0.958 downstream.
watch_item: The first-stage surrogate cannot extrapolate in tip-speed ratio; coefficients apply to fixed-pitch, prescribed-speed operation where both rotors attain the simulated ratio below rated wind speed.
paper_title: Surrogate-Based Optimization of Tandem Twin-Rotor Wind Turbines Accounting for Wake Interactions
